instruction: Walk past the fridge, up the steps, and into the hall. Stop next to the first door on the left.

steps.thought: The fridge is visible ahead near the hallway. I'll walk toward it, then proceed up the steps into the hall.
The hallway with steps and the fridge are ahead. I'll walk toward the fridge and the opening to the hall.
The fridge and the steps up to the hallway are visible ahead, slightly right of center. I'll turn right to align with the opening, then move toward the steps.
The fridge and the steps up to the hall are ahead. I'll advance toward the steps, then climb and look for the first door on the left.
The fridge and steps are ahead; I need to approach them, go up the steps into the hall, then find the first door on the left.
I'm facing the steps and hall beyond the fridge. I'll advance toward the steps and then into the hall.
I'm near the fridge with the steps ahead leading up to the hall. I'll advance toward and up the steps, then look for the first door on the left.
I'm at the base of the steps with the hall ahead; the first door on the left is the white door at the top-left of the stairs. I'll climb the steps and approach it.
I've drifted to face a blank wall; the stairs and hall are to my left. I'll turn left to re-aim at the hallway.
I'm at the base of the stairs; the hallway with the first door on the left is up the steps and slightly left. I'll turn left toward the staircase and climb.
I've ascended the steps and can see a white door ahead in the hall. I'll advance toward it and stop beside it.
I'm facing a wall after climbing the steps; the hallway with the door is to my right. I need to turn right and re-observe.
I'm now in the hall facing the brown door. The first door on the left was the white door seen earlier near the top of the steps, so I should turn left to face it and stop there.
I'm facing a blank wall; the hallway with the door on the left was behind me to the right. I'll turn right to re-face down the hall.
I'm in the hall with the staircase on the right and the brown door ahead. The first door on the left should be along the left wall just ahead, so I'll advance a couple of steps and then stop.
I'm in the hall with the staircase on the right and a brown door ahead. The first door on the left should be along the left wall; I'll advance toward it and stop beside it.
I'm in the hall by the stairs; the brown door ahead on the left is the first door on the left. I'll advance a couple steps toward it and stop.
I'm in the hall now; the brown door ahead is the first door on the left side of the hall. I'll advance toward it and stop beside it.
I'm facing a wall corner; the hallway with the brown front door is to my left. I'll turn left and proceed down the hall toward the first door on the left.
I'm in the hall facing the brown door, which is the first door on the left after entering the hall. I'm close to it, so I'll stop.
